exact_theorem: For every unweighted simple vertex-transitive graph on d vertices of degree r>0 and clique number omega, the paired edge frame Auv=Euv+Evu, Buv=i(Euv-Evu) has V=2r, unrestricted common-ensemble k=2(1-1/omega), and W<=2(r+t)I<(V+k)I, where t>0 solves t(t+r/(1-1/omega))=r. Thus C2 holds for every normalized extension, including all legal tracial self-compatible channels.
additional_exact_theorem: For any vertex-transitive graph in this class the true legal-channel score optimum is its glued-copy Perron root, attained by an explicit CPTP, unital, HS-self-adjoint, self-compatible resolvent broadcaster. Balanced complete multipartite graphs attain the spectral upper bound and their ratios tend2 from below.
historical_importance: The known Motzkin-Straus clique optimization supplies exact unrestricted k. The resulting graph construction was a plausible counterexample route to the programme's general broadcast gate; this proof closes that route rather than claiming the general endpoint.

strongest_checked_primary_prior.authors: T. S. Motzkin and E. G. Straus
strongest_checked_primary_prior.title: Maxima for Graphs and a New Proof of a Theorem of Turan
strongest_checked_primary_prior.scope: Simplex maximization via clique number; publisher metadata/extract checked and needed theorem independently re-proved.

new_mechanism: Exact equality-coordinate star decomposition, root-neighborhood spectral clique bound, positive resolvent supersolution, and symmetric resolvent Kraus construction with an independent HS adjoint check.
load_bearing_missing_lemma_for_general_t: No reduction from arbitrary Hermitian frames to this equal paired-edge vertex-transitive family was established. All positive frame weights and tracial constrained supports would need control before a common-EB span consequence could follow.
compatibility_obligations: Both quadratures are present with equal weight on each unweighted edge.
Vertex transitivity is used to attain the pure maximum with tracial barycenter and to normalize the symmetric legal resolvent construction.
Regularity and clique number are used in the coalescence spectral bound.
The Choi transpose changes the sign of the imaginary quadrature.
Transitivity alone is insufficient for HS self-adjointness; symmetric resolvent population weights supply it.
The isotropic frame result is not an all-frame common-EB theorem.
early_falsification_test: A single exact K_{2,2,2} replay reconstructs V=8, k=4/3, legal s=1+sqrt13 and ratio5(7+sqrt13)/27<2; all channel obligations and the 64-state support ensemble pass in Q(sqrt13).
likely_significance: An exact obstruction to this counterexample mechanism and an analytic sharpness family. It narrows the general search while leaving the arbitrary-frame question open.
